_doc: E01: model screening. 8 tests x 3 models x 1 take, 5-6 s, same start frame + same intent per test. n=1 is SCREENING only; winners are replicated in E01b. Durations set from real /estimate prices (2026-10-07): Seedance 4s@480p ~$0.82, Kling 4s ~$0.57, Hailuo 6s $0.24. Niches: drinks (T01,T02,T08), tech (T03), food (T04), people/UGC (T05), beauty (T06), fashion/FOOH (T07). All brands fictional.
